title: I Want My Hat Back
author: Jon Klassen

hero.name: Bear (I Want My Hat Back)
hero.description: Simple brown bear character from Jon Klassen's distinctive minimalist illustration style
hero.source_note: Generic brown bear from Boardmaker library should work; Klassen's style is minimalist so exact match not critical

ambiguous.issue: Could map to bear (animal) or bear (verb: to carry/tolerate)
ambiguous.reason: Bear is the main character — the animal meaning is correct

notes: The core story revolves around bear losing his red hat, asking various animals if they have seen it, and eventually remembering that the rabbit was wearing it. Key vocabulary priorities are: hat (central object), red (hat's defining colour), the three most plot-relevant animals (rabbit — the thief, fox, snake), and the narrative actions (lost, found, search, ask, remember). 'Eat' is included because bear ultimately eats the rabbit — a darkly humorous climax students often react strongly to and may want to comment on. 'Rabbit' and 'snake' already exist in activity_images; 'lost', 'found', and 'remember' already exist in aac_extras — these can be reused directly.
